name: Niẓām al-Dīn al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Qummī al-Nīsābūrī
summary: Scholar of Nishapur, astronomer and Qurʾān commentator, whose commentary on al-Shāfiya, Sharḥ al-Niẓām, was read in the madrasas of Iran, India and the Ottoman lands.
bio: Niẓām al-Dīn came from a family of Qum and lived in Nishapur. He wrote a large commentary on the Qurʾān, Gharāʾib al-Qurʾān, and commentaries on the astronomy of Naṣīr al-Dīn al-Ṭūsī.

His Sharḥ al-Shāfiya, known in the madrasas simply as al-Niẓām, explains Ibn al-Ḥājib's ṣarf at a middle length between al-Jārabardī's and al-Raḍī's, and was a set book of the advanced ṣarf in India. He died around 730/1329.
uncertain: His year of death is not known; dates from 728/1328 to after 750/1349 are given.
